original: たまには休まないと、体調を崩すよ。

en.text: If you don't rest once in a while, you'll get sick.
If you don't take a break once in a while, you'll get sick.

original: そんなに頑張ったら、体調崩すよ。

en.text: If you work that hard, you're going to burn out.
If you put that much effort in, your body's going to collapse.

original: 折角ここまで頑張って積み上げたのに、もう崩すの？もったいない！

en.text: After all that effort to build it up, you're already going to knock it down? What a waste!
